# variant: # variant     all | none | php | php-config | ts | ts-config | github — `all` applies everywhere, the rest match
#             prefix:N    the first N lines are the seed; the rest is per-repo history
#             masked:RE   identical after RE is blanked on both sides
# Excluded by design, and recorded here so the absence is not read as an oversight:
#   version.txt                     per-repo state; `release-type: simple` writes it, and it
#                                   exists only in variants with no package manifest to hold
#                                   the version — a prose repository's manifest is one line
#   CHANGELOG.md                    written by the Release PR, never seeded
#   CLAUDE.md                       seeded once from templates/, then per-repo content
# .gitattributes is per-variant, not `all`: its export-ignore list names the tool
# configs of one language, and a package that SHIPS configuration must export the
# very files a library hides. One `all` copy could only be right for one of them.
